steps: Sign up free once on your phone for Presto Insta-Shops
Open Prestomap and view nearby shops with their payment amounts
Self-assign a shop instantly (no scheduler approval)
Complete the shop and fill out the survey on the spot
Get paid in hours to days via PayPal (cash), Amazon, or TangoCard credit
